1.name: Pilot
1.overview: While scouting the world of Flappers the Super Dolphin, Kit, Kaboodle, and Gobbles are attacked by the Syntax and crash-land, separating Kaboodle from the others. Kit and Gobbles unknowingly befriend the game's hero, Flappers, while Kaboodle meets and trains its villain, Snappers, to defeat him. Meanwhile, Syntax agents Fold and Miss Information manipulate Flappers into completing the game's objectives. Upon discovering the truth, Kit panics and reveals the nature of the game world, nearly destroying it. Despite the trio reuniting, Flappers defeats Snappers with Fold's help, triggering the world's destruction. Kit, Kaboodle, and Gobbles escape with Flappers, while Snappers is captured and killed by the Syntax after refusing to join them. Syntax leader Warrick then offers Malice and Mayhem, villains from Kit's world, a chance for revenge.
